g.text: Analog divider22k/33k: gain0.600; ADC0-3.0V for input0-5V. ADC source14.2kohm requires long sampling time.

g.desc: Analog divider22k/33k: gain0.600; ADC0-3.0V for input0-5V. ADC source14.2kohm requires long sampling time.

g.text: Continuous accidental +/-12.6V inputs are resistor-limited design cases, NOT tested survival ratings.

g.desc: Continuous accidental +/-12.6V inputs are resistor-limited design cases, NOT tested survival ratings.

g.text: Signal sources and USB must be disconnected while board is unpowered. Sensor rail shares logic buck current limit.

g.desc: Signal sources and USB must be disconnected while board is unpowered. Sensor rail shares logic buck current limit.

g.text: Positive comparator feedback1M gives approx72mV input hysteresis; input RC approx13us; measure edge delay.

g.desc: Positive comparator feedback1M gives approx72mV input hysteresis; input RC approx13us; measure edge delay.

g.text: Trigger inputs: single-ended push-pull0-5V Hall/function generator only. No onboard Hall pullup, no VR interface.

g.desc: Trigger inputs: single-ended push-pull0-5V Hall/function generator only. No onboard Hall pullup, no VR interface.

g.text: BAT54S clamps to AGND and dedicated absorbing LM4040 3.0V shunt. No phantom powering of MCU rail.

g.desc: BAT54S clamps to AGND and dedicated absorbing LM4040 3.0V shunt. No phantom powering of MCU rail.
